_comment: The commentary script, and the single source of truth for it.
Tools/bake_commentary.sh reads this and writes one WAV per entry into
Assets/Audio/Commentary/. Temp/evals/build_commentary_bank.cs reads the same file and
fills CommentaryBank.asset with the text and the matching clip. Keeping both ends on one
file is the point: a line whose spoken audio and printed subtitle disagree is worse than
having no subtitle at all, and that is exactly what two hand-maintained lists produce.
'usesName' prefixes the line with the fighter's own name clip at playback, so the body
has to be phrased to follow one - 'is in real trouble' rather than 'he is in real
trouble'. Bodies that name nobody are phrased to stand alone.
Four variants per event, matching the rule the impact sounds already follow: a match is
the same handful of events fired over and over, and the ear locks onto a repeated
waveform far faster than the eye locks onto a repeated sprite.
